basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old gamer based in Austin, Texas. I recently got into Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and stock enthusiasts. I work part-time at a local electronics store and am studying computer science at a community college. I enjoy spending my evenings gaming on my PS4, especially playing Dark Souls 3. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends online. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a budding interest in video games and stock trading. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from playing various games and watching online tutorials. I'm also learning about stock trading through forums, though I'm still a beginner.
